'''Life Day robes''' were a set of robes used in the celebration of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] holiday [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. They were [[red]] in color, and were made to cover the entire body, except for the head. During one particular Life Day celebration, it was sold along with the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[LD-1 Celebrator]], the [[Life Day Holo-Tree]], the [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orb]] and the [[Life Day Tinsel Bomb]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', December 2012 Life Day celebration</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Life Day robes first appeared in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''. In popular culture, the Snuggie&mdash;a [[Wikipedia:Sleeved blanket|sleeved blanket]] product&mdash;has been humorously compared to Life Day robes by a number of websites and bloggers.<ref name="snuggie1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.infomercial-hell.com/blog/2008/12/03/chewbacca-and-his-wookie-family-wear-snuggies|text=Chewbacca and His Wookie Family Wear Snuggies!|author=Paul Lucas|date=2008-12-03|work=Ridiculous Infomercial Review|archivedate=20200222151011}}</ref><ref name="snuggie2">{{WebCite|url=http://snuggiesightings.com/snuggie/red-snuggie-star-wars-party-in-spokane|text=Red Snuggie Star Wars Party in Spokane|work=Snuggie Sightings|archivedate=20200101210625}}</ref><ref name="snuggie3">{{Blogspot|subdomain=worldwidewookieelifeday|url=2010/11/wookiee-life-day-2010-press-release.html|name=World Wide Wookiee Life Day|text=Wookiee Life Day 2010 Press Release|date=2010-11-12}}</ref><ref name="snuggie4">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/Wookiee_Life_Day_134908.asp?format=1|text=Wookiee Life Day|author=Dustin|date=2010-11-12|format=1|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20200103101304}}</ref>
